Lauren Klein

Client Strategy Paralegal

Lauren works closely with multiple departments to ensure excellent client service from day one. She gathers information from prospective clients to ensure their matters align with our practice areas and regions we serve, and prepares them for their consultation. She also works closely with the marketing department to gather and track data. and uses her prior experience as a bankruptcy paralegal to support the student loan adversary team.
